From: Olivia Grant <olivia@hearthwell.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 5 Jul 2026 14:12:00 -0400
Subject: Post-call recap + next asks (org chain & decision owners)

Hi Karthik and Laura —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our side and a few asks so we can move internal approvals along: 

- Pilot scope we discussed: 3-week inference pilot for care-coordination prompts, up to 50k tokens/day. (See attached hearthwell-pilot-scope.pdf.)
- Primary success criteria: 95% latency under 350ms p50 and no PHI leakage in outputs.
- Key open items you flagged: SOC 2 evidence, data retention options, and contract SLA language.

To speed approvals, can you send a short list of the people we should introduce across our teams? Specifically: 
1) Economic buyer (who signs/owns budget)
2) Security/compliance contact for SOC 2 and data handling questions
3) Legal contact to review contract terms and any preferred redlines
4) Procurement contact for PO and SOW routing

If you have a simple template or org roster we can fill out, that would be ideal. Our preferred internal timeline is: procurement questions answered by 7/10, legal review by 7/14, and pilot kickoff week of 7/20 if all good.

Happy to loop in our procurement lead if helpful — I can do an intro if you send the contact names.

Thanks,
Olivia
Olivia Grant
VP of Digital Transformation, Hearthwell Health
olivia@hearthwell.com

Attachments: hearthwell-pilot-scope.pdf (PDF, 240KB)

- Ben (cc'd) will produce a short commercial/contract timeline and the standard pilot SOW for you to review by 7/8.
- If you can share names for the roles above by 7/8, we'll get procurement and legal materials over to your team by 7/10.

If it's helpful, I propose a 30m sync with: Olivia, your procurement lead, our security engineer (Laura), Ben (commercial), and me. Tentative slot: Thu 7/9 11am ET — open for that?

Hi all — looping in a short procurement checklist that we typically use for health systems. A few quick notes: 

- Economic buyer is often a VP/Director of Product or Digital; if billing must route to finance we need the PO owner listed.
- Security contact: we need a direct engineer or manager who can validate SSO, network egress rules, and any required IP allowlists.
- Legal: we can accept a redline via DocuSign or Word; please indicate any required carrier/indemnity language up front.

Tentative commercial timeline from our side (subject to your staffing): 
- 7/8: draft pilot SOW and commercial terms to Hearthwell (Ben)
- 7/10: security questionnaire responses delivered (Laura)
- 7/14: legal redline window opens/feedback due
- 7/20: pilot kickoff if approvals complete

If you prefer, we can provide a short narrative for each role in the template — happy to populate based on your org chart.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Account Director | Redwood Inference

Goal from our side: turn around procurement sign-off by 7/14 so we can approve the pilot spend and schedule the kickoff week of 7/20. If you can get the SOC 2 and SSO answers to us by EOD 7/10 that would keep us on track.

Thanks — Samir
